name: Signal Horizon
central_idea: A clear luminous route emerges from a complex operating landscape.

visual_language.lighting: Blue-hour depth with a warm directional horizon.
visual_language.photography: Cinematic commercial realism with negative space for bilingual copy.

glass_profile.intent: Use depth to communicate hierarchy, not to decorate every surface.
glass_profile.fallback: Opaque semantic surface with equivalent contrast.

hero.narrative: A port route becomes visible as the camera advances toward the horizon.
hero.desktop_composition: Wide central depth with safe copy regions on both outer thirds.
hero.mobile_composition: Portrait crop preserves the vessel and a single upper copy-safe region.

approval.note: Creative approval applies only to the fictional reference.
